recaptureNote: Every entry below was re-evaluated against the 2026-08-04 re-pin from 9739c4a2 to 80dff0a9. For each family the upstream Rust source paths were diffed across the two refs; a family is 'unchanged (verified)' only when that diff is empty or provably non-semantic for the asserted content, and 'recaptured' when the fixture had to be re-derived from the new-pin source. Per-file evidence lives in each fixture's own `provenance` block.
